system.description:
Size: Medium. Humans have no special bonuses or penalties due to their size.

Ability Modifiers: None.

Base Speed: 30 feet.

Starting Feats: Two, as every basic class puts it: “the two feats all characters get at 1st level”. A nonhuman character gains only one.

Skill Points: The full allowance printed for each class. A nonhuman character gets one fewer per level, and so four fewer at 1st level.
system.freeLanguages: Read/Write Common (or local language), Speak Common (or local language).
system.otherLanguages: Any, by spending skill points on Read/Write Language and Speak Language.

traits.name: Starting Feats
traits.description: A human character receives two feats at 1st level, as every basic class states: “the two feats all characters get at 1st level”. A nonhuman character gains only one.

traits.name: Skill Points
traits.description: A human character gains the full skill point allowance printed for each class. A nonhuman character gets 4 fewer at 1st level and 1 fewer each level thereafter.
